description: Feature 3.5 no silent clipping — frontend enforcement validation
principle: Frontend must not silently change invalid user input to valid before sending to API
scenario: User enters value outside range → frontend must show error OR block submission

frontend_form_validation.build_form_defaults: Uses slider/number input with range from /features metadata
frontend_form_validation.streamlit_widget_enforcement: Widgets may constrain min/max from feature metadata

backend_enforcement: Even if frontend constrains, backend must independently validate
